title: Force magnitude correct
description: Essential: The student's answer must give the magnitude of the force as 1.0 × 10⁻⁸ N.

title: Force direction correct
description: Essential: The student must correctly state the force on q1 is attractive, directed from A toward B (to the left).

title: Applies Coulomb's law
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Coulomb's law, F = k|q1q2|/r², with proper unit conversion (cm to m).

title: Field from force definition
description: Important: For part (2), the student must correctly use the definition E = F/q (using the test charge q1) to find the field at A.

title: Field magnitude correct
description: Essential: The student's answer must give the electric field magnitude at A as 100 N/C for both parts (2) and (3).

title: Field direction correct
description: Important: The student must correctly state the field direction at A is away from q2 (to the right) for both parts (2) and (3).

title: Superposition principle applied
description: Important: For part (3), the student must recognize that the field at A is due solely to q2 after q1 is removed.

title: Unit conversion error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student fails to convert the distance from 30 cm to 0.30 m in Coulomb's law.

title: Sign/direction confusion
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student confuses the sign of charges, leading to incorrect force or field direction.

title: Unit analysis or clarity
description: Optional: Award credit for explicitly showing unit analysis or providing a clear, step-by-step derivation.
